title: QA routine round 2 (2026-11-17) close-out anchor: checklist-accuracy notes, partial coverage gaps and two runner-tool notes
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

The wave anchor for `qa#1`'s routine round 2 (`checklist-test` §5). Routine rounds have no sweep card, so the round's records park their non-extracted items here:

- #34801 `surface:api`
- #34802 `owed:weekly`
- #34803 `priority:P0`
- the `touched:b914e724` record, still running, which adds its own lines when filed

The evidence for each line is on the record named. Nothing here is a product defect: those were extracted, or added to open cards. A line here is a checklist edit (`checklist-test` §3), a fixture, or a pin upgrade.

## Checklist-accuracy notes (item edits, revision bump)

- `access-security.me-permissions-aggregation-parity` A5: the stock showcase locks currency through the tracked `.env` (`OS_LOCALIZATION_CURRENCY=USD`), so the PUT answers 409 SETTINGS_LOCKED. (#34801)
- `api-backend.date-range-preset-matrix` A1: the evidence text says "the 13-row table", but DATE_RANGE_PRESETS has 16 members. (#34801)
- `approvals.sla-escalation` steps[7]: it says the sweep logs nothing, but at info level it logs `SLA escalation sweep {"scanned":N,"escalated":M}`. (#34801)
- `api-backend.route-ledger-live-parity` step 4: the personal-view and comment-reaction ledgers list only `DELETE …/:id`, so a GET on the base path is the routing 404. (#34801)
- `ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate` A4/N1: under an `osk_` key, run_action of revoke_api_key is answered first by the confirmation gate (428), not the credential gate the prose predicts. (#34801)
- `access-security.sharing-rules-widen` knownGaps[1]: explain now answers decidedBy "sharing" on the matching contact, not "depth". (#34801)
- `platform-core.docs-audience-gate`: the permissionSet-gated book still needs runtime staging; a recipe that works is in #34801.
- `dashboards.cube-query` steps[0]: the showcase refuses `--preset minimal` at config load, so the absent-slot arm (negative[1], and acceptance[4]'s 404 half) has no showcase door at all. (#34802)
- `records-forms.field-unique-enforcement` acceptance[3].verify should name the atomic batch `updateMany` door that `automated.ref` scores. (#34802)
- `ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason` (#34802):
  - The canvas FieldStub previews (12 natively disabled inputs, inert by design) need a carve-out, or the product should mark them `inert`.
  - Three field-inspector groups show no tooltip on keyboard focus.
- `platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal`: the cold-boot warning says "its namespace prefixed, as above", but nothing prefixed is printed when the later holder has no namespace. (#34802)
- `platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render` steps[5] and acceptance[4].evidence say 8 Account destinations; it now serves 9 (`nav_account_mobile_app`). (#34803)
- `platform-core.boot-health` steps[3]: the example seed reads 138 rows; this boot reads 141. (#34803)
- `approvals.account-app-entry` acceptance[6]: "Preferences › Language" is a labelled row with a switch, not a menu item. (#34803)
- `ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed` fixtures.requires[3]: `qa-fixture contributor-member --position showcase_client_liaison` keeps the contributor binding, so a runner scoring as-is reads a false field leak. The item should say to drop the binding, or the fixture should offer an only-this-position option. (#34803)
- `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony` acceptance[5]: list the rule-derived `sys_record_share` row that the second boot's sharing reconcile re-creates. (#34803)
- `integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix` acceptance[0]: the key-naming sentence sits in `error.details.hint`, not the top-level message; say where to read it. (#34803)
- RUNNER walled-boot entry (#34803):
  - `qa-fixture teardown --dir` deletes runner logs kept inside that directory.
  - A fresh operator sign-in lands in the Default Organization; call `set-active` before creating rows.

## Partial coverage gaps (pin upgrade or fixture)

- **#34801:** 38 PARTIAL items.
  - Pinned below the oracle's layer (no HTTP pin): access-security ×7, api-backend ×2, ai ×3, attachments-storage ×4, plus `automation.paused-run-trigger-record-masked`, `identity-auth.pending-sso-users-managed` and `platform-core.docs-audience-gate` A2.
  - Fixture-blocked clauses: 6.
  - Live legs not reached this round: 16.
  - Each is named in the record's derived-verdicts section.
- **#34802:**
  - `cli.datasource-introspect-codegen` acceptance[0] needs a schema-bearing driver (knownGaps[2]).
  - `ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names` acceptance[0] needs a writable scratch package and a pending suggested binding.
- **#34803:**
  - `access-security.rls-both-sides` acceptance[5] (dependency #7463);
  - `access-security.crud-permission-matrix` acceptance[5] (dependency #23267).

## Runner-tool notes

- `scripts/qa/retest-owed.mjs`: `JUDGED_WORD` matches "fail" inside the id `ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed`, so #34803's PASS line for that item is displayed as `fail`. Judged-or-not is still right. Measured with the script's own `readRecordItems`.
- `scripts/pm/close-cards.mjs` counts a `pm:mailbox` PR that merely mentions a card as "an open PR references it" and skips the closure. A mailbox PR's own body says mailboxes are excluded from every landing ledger. Seen on #32135, which was closed through the relay's comment and `issue_patch` instead.
